BACKGROUND

A little background

The release statement on POCLANOS says “NO PAIN” began with questions about living through time and what it means to transcend time and space. The single was released on August 25, 2022.

  • POCLANOS — NO PAIN release statement and credits (Korean and English) ↗

INSIDE THE LYRICS

An invitation with room for uncertainty

  • Belonging
  • Leaving

The house the speaker has made offers a concrete place for people who have been excluded. Singing together is the invitation: belonging begins with something they can share. The warmth of a communal fire extends that welcome, giving the gathering a small, tangible centre.

Yet the speaker also thinks of leaving and asks not to be hated. Wanting others close does not settle whether the speaker will stay. Later, love entrusted to the sun and figures gathering in thick night fog make the scene harder to place. Those images leave the gathering’s purpose uncertain, without undoing the opening wish for company.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 실리카겔

Silica Gel

Silica Gel is a four-piece band with two vocalists: guitarist Kim Chunchu and keyboardist Kim Hanjoo, joined by drummer Kim Geonjay and bassist Choi Woonghee.

Their self-titled first album earned them Rookie of the Year at the Korean Music Awards.
